project_kinds.name: Autoconsumatore individuale di energia rinnovabile a distanza
project_kinds.description: An individual renewable self-consumer at a distance: one final customer consuming, through the distribution grid, the energy of renewable plants it holds on another site than its consumption.
project_kinds.reference: Article 30, paragraph 1: the individual self-consumer, including the one whose plant stands at a site other than its consumption and uses the distribution grid

project_kinds.name: Gruppo di autoconsumatori di energia rinnovabile che agiscono collettivamente
project_kinds.description: A group of renewable self-consumers acting jointly: at least two final customers in the same building or condominium, sharing the energy of the renewable plants of the building.

project_kinds.name: Comunità energetica rinnovabile (CER)
project_kinds.description: A renewable energy community: an autonomous legal entity of open and voluntary participation, controlled by members — natural persons, small and medium enterprises, local authorities, associations and other bodies named by the act — near its plants, whose main purpose is environmental, economic or social benefit for its members or the areas where it operates rather than financial profit.
